world_seed.visual_direction: A brass-and-glass railway greenhouse, living platform signs, seed drawers, damp timber, and crops changing visibly between stations.

institutions.name: Platform Allotment Office
institutions.mandate: Assign platform access according to documented crop-tending commitments for each journey segment.
institutions.decision_rule: Release access slots only when every crop bay has enough named passengers covering its watering, pruning, pollination, and harvest windows.
institutions.enforced_by: Conductors scan signed tending rosters at greenhouse gates and suspend access when duties are missed.
institutions.visible_output: A public platform board showing unlocked destinations, assigned passengers, crops, and duty windows.

institutions.name: Carriage Horticultural Guild
institutions.mandate: Keep the moving greenhouse healthy and certify that passenger care is competent.
institutions.decision_rule: Approve a tending plan when crop-specific skills, tools, and labour overlap with each crop's needs.
institutions.enforced_by: Guild gardeners inspect bays, issue training requirements, and quarantine neglected or diseased crops.
institutions.visible_output: Colour-coded crop health tags, quarantine ribbons, and competency stamps on passenger tickets.

institutions.name: Railway Provision Council
institutions.mandate: Balance harvested food, seed reserves, and route demand across stations.
institutions.decision_rule: Allocate produce and leaf credits by verified labour, crop scarcity, and upcoming station shortages.
institutions.enforced_by: Locked harvest cabinets, audited weighings, and withholding of seed or supply allocations.
institutions.visible_output: A carriage ledger listing harvest shares, seed stocks, shortages, and station-bound crates.

institutions.name: Passenger Compact Assembly
institutions.mandate: Resolve disputes over burdensome crops, substitutions, and collective access priorities.
institutions.decision_rule: A proposal passes with a two-thirds vote of passengers whose current duties or destinations would change.
institutions.enforced_by: Signed compact amendments become binding roster instructions for conductors and guild gardeners.
institutions.visible_output: Posted votes, amended duty swaps, appeals, and destination priorities.

state_variables.label: Crop duty coverage
state_variables.initial_tension: Popular destinations attract promises, but difficult night duties and allergenic crops remain uncovered.
changed_by: Passengers sign, trade, split, or abandon crop duties.
The assembly changes destination priorities or approves substitutions.
Guild training makes specialist duties available to more passengers.
affects: Whether crops receive care at the correct time.

state_variables.label: Greenhouse crop health
state_variables.initial_tension: Several bays are thriving while delicate fruiting crops are close to stress during long segments.
changed_by: Passengers water, prune, pollinate, treat, harvest, neglect, or mishandle assigned crops.
Guild gardeners quarantine disease or teach corrective care.
Route delays alter heat and watering schedules.
affects: The number of bays requiring urgent labour.

state_variables.label: Available platform access
state_variables.initial_tension: Only destinations backed by complete tending rosters are open, leaving some passengers stranded from preferred stops.
changed_by: The Platform Allotment Office unlocks or suspends slots after roster audits.
Passengers complete critical duties or negotiate replacement carers.
Crop quarantine changes which commitments count toward access.
affects: Who may board, transfer, or disembark.
Crowding and bargaining power aboard the train.

state_variables.label: Passenger trust in agreements
state_variables.initial_tension: Travellers need one another to reach destinations but suspect others will abandon duties after gaining access.
changed_by: Passengers fulfil promises, witness care, disclose conflicts, broker fair swaps, or default.
Institutions publish accurate or disputed records.
Harvest and access rewards are distributed consistently or unfairly.
affects: Willingness to sign shared tending plans.
Ease of recruiting replacements for difficult crops.

state_variables.label: Journey provision reserve
state_variables.initial_tension: Food is sufficient for the current run, but future segments depend on timely harvests and fair rationing.
changed_by: Healthy crops are harvested and allocated.
Passengers consume, trade, preserve, donate, or conceal produce.
The Provision Council redirects crates toward station shortages.
affects: Pressure to prioritise fast crops over diverse crops.

state_variables.label: Viable seed diversity
state_variables.initial_tension: The greenhouse carries many varieties, but scarce platform slots encourage passengers to favour easy, high-yield crops.
changed_by: Passengers save mature seed, cross-pollinate varieties, consume seed stock, or replace difficult crops.
The Provision Council funds scarce varieties.
Crop disease or premature harvest destroys viable seed.
affects: Which crops can be planted on later journeys.
Resilience to disease and changing station needs.
Future combinations of duties that can unlock access.

causal_links.trigger: Passengers fill every time-sensitive duty for a destination's required crop bays.
causal_links.effect: The office unlocks additional boarding and transfer slots for that destination.
causal_links.delay: At the next roster audit before arrival.

causal_links.trigger: A promised watering, pruning, or pollination window passes without a qualified carer.
causal_links.effect: Affected bays lose health and may require more specialised recovery duties.
causal_links.delay: Visible within one journey segment; severe damage appears after two.

causal_links.trigger: Healthy crops reach their certified harvest window and passengers complete harvesting correctly.
causal_links.effect: Edible stores and tradable harvest shares increase.
causal_links.delay: After weighing at the next staffed carriage checkpoint.

causal_links.trigger: Reserves fall below the council's next-segment requirement.
causal_links.effect: Hungry or fatigued passengers avoid demanding duties unless offered larger harvest shares.
causal_links.delay: During the following duty negotiation round.

causal_links.trigger: Public records confirm that signatories completed duties and received the promised access.
causal_links.effect: More passengers accept shared and interdependent tending plans.

causal_links.trigger: New transfer slots bring aboard passengers with rare horticultural skills.
causal_links.effect: Specialist treatment becomes possible for fragile or quarantined bays.
causal_links.delay: One segment after those passengers board.

causal_links.trigger: Passengers repeatedly favour rapid harvests and collect crops before seeds mature.
causal_links.effect: Fewer viable varieties remain for future planting.
causal_links.delay: Revealed when seed drawers are audited at journey's end.

causal_links.trigger: Seed diversity declines below the needs of upcoming climates and station diets.
causal_links.effect: Fewer destination-compatible crop plans can be offered, reducing unlockable platform routes.
causal_links.delay: During planning for the next full railway circuit.

causal_links.trigger: Access is suspended after defaults by a few highly connected passengers.
causal_links.effect: Stranded passengers question collective agreements and demand narrower, individually guaranteed duties.
causal_links.delay: Immediate dispute, with stronger effects at the next assembly vote.

causal_links.trigger: The council allocates surplus produce transparently to workers and food-short stations.
causal_links.effect: Passengers become more willing to accept difficult duties for delayed communal rewards.
causal_links.delay: After recipients and shipment weights are publicly verified.

stakeholder_groups.name: Destination-Bound Passengers
stakeholder_groups.goal: Unlock their required platforms with the least disruptive crop labour possible.
stakeholder_groups.leverage: They can sign, bundle, trade, or withhold the commitments needed to complete a destination roster.
stakeholder_groups.dependency: They need other passengers to cover incompatible duty times and need office approval for access.

stakeholder_groups.name: Mobile Growers' Collective
stakeholder_groups.goal: Protect crop health and preserve difficult varieties even when doing so slows access.
stakeholder_groups.leverage: Members possess rare tending skills and can certify practical duty swaps through guild standing.
stakeholder_groups.dependency: They need passengers for routine labour and council-controlled tools, seed, and harvest space.

stakeholder_groups.name: Station Provision Delegates
stakeholder_groups.goal: Direct harvests toward food-short stations and prioritise routes carrying essential produce.
stakeholder_groups.leverage: They provide shortage forecasts, destination demand, storage rights, and favourable produce contracts.
stakeholder_groups.dependency: They need healthy harvests, unlocked unloading platforms, and passengers willing to tend station-specific crops.

stakeholder_groups.name: Independent Access Brokers
stakeholder_groups.goal: Profit by assembling crop-duty coalitions and reselling scarce access opportunities.
stakeholder_groups.leverage: They coordinate fragmented schedules, offer leaf-credit advances, and rapidly recruit replacement carers.
stakeholder_groups.dependency: They need trustworthy roster information, enforceable duty transfers, and persistent scarcity of platform slots.

genre: Cooperative botanical railway simulation with negotiation and light institutional drama
premise: A travelling greenhouse railway unlocks platform access only when passengers collectively agree to tend specific crops throughout each journey.
simulation_objective: Negotiate credible tending rosters, keep crops and seed lines alive, distribute harvests, and expand access without exhausting trust or labour.
economy_focus: Labour-backed platform access, crop yields, seed scarcity, produce allocation, and leaf-credit contracts.
exploration_focus: Unlocking stations and route branches by forming destination-specific crop-care agreements.
conflict_tone: Nonviolent bargaining, defaults, rationing disputes, ecological trade-offs, and contested collective rules.
visual_style: Luminous solarpunk railcars with Victorian greenhouse geometry, tactile paper ledgers, enamel signs, and visibly evolving plant bays.

gameplay_loops.label: Roster, Serve, Unlock
gameplay_loops.summary: The Fourfold Roster Broker assembles watering, pruning, pollination, and harvest coverage in the Allotment Roster Office. Completed windows raise crop commitment coverage; the next audit activates the causal link that increases platform access capacity.
gameplay_loops.pressure: A single uncovered night or allergen duty can suspend every linked access slot.

gameplay_loops.label: Treat, Certify, Recover
gameplay_loops.summary: The Quarantine Passage Assayer and Living-Pollen Substitution Tutor diagnose and retrain care in the Horticultural Practice Car, then apply a certified plan in the Delicate Fruiting Bay. Success raises greenhouse crop health; failure triggers the missed-duty link that creates specialist recovery work.
gameplay_loops.pressure: Delay, disease, and narrow care windows can make the safest treatment incompatible with destination rosters.

gameplay_loops.label: Harvest, Weigh, Allocate
gameplay_loops.summary: The Shortage-Crate Weighmaster audits harvests in the Provision Weighing Car while the Edible-Route Delay Forecaster tests station demand. Correct harvest and weighing activate the crop-health link that increases journey provision reserve, while transparent allocation can raise passenger trust.
gameplay_loops.pressure: Immediate worker rewards compete with reserves and crates promised to food-short stations.

gameplay_loops.label: Mature, Witness, Preserve
gameplay_loops.summary: The Seed-Lineage Archive Witness records whether crops are allowed to mature, then audits viable seed in the Seed Reserve Archive. Mature collection raises seed diversity; repeated early harvest activates its decline and later reduces platform access capacity.
gameplay_loops.pressure: Passengers need food now, but upcoming climates require scarce lineages that yield slowly.

gameplay_loops.label: Amend, Vote, Rebuild Trust
gameplay_loops.summary: The Compact Burden Cartographer maps unequal duty effects in the Passenger Compact Assembly Car, and the Shared-Shift Trust Lamplighter tests a substitution before a two-thirds vote. Fair amendments raise passenger trust and improve later crop commitment coverage.
gameplay_loops.pressure: Every concession changes whose destination, exposure, or rest window bears the cost.

player_entry_points: Take an uncovered night duty in the Allotment Roster Office to help unlock a preferred destination.
Contest a shortage allocation after an audited weighing in the Provision Weighing Car.
Seek a competency stamp in the Horticultural Practice Car before volunteering for delicate crop care.
Witness a disputed seed drawer audit in the Seed Reserve Archive.
conflict_hooks: A nearly complete destination roster lacks one allergenic night-pollination duty. Several passengers want the platform unlocked, but no one accepts the burden without protected equipment, extra harvest shares, and a guaranteed replacement after one segment.

A shortage crate is redirected toward an underfed station, reducing rewards promised to passengers who completed difficult duties. The weighing is accurate, but the compact never specified whether station need outranks labour claims.

Delicate fruit can be harvested now to restore provisions or left to mature for viable seed. Delay forecasts suggest waiting may damage the crop, while the archive warns that early harvest will erase a scarce lineage.

A quarantine ribbon invalidates commitments that had unlocked several transfers. Stranded passengers demand those commitments still count, while guild evidence indicates ordinary carers could spread disease.

open_action_examples.situation: A destination roster lacks two night watering windows, and the broker offers a larger harvest share for taking both.
coordinator_checks: Verify the offered harvest share exists and is controlled by the initiating party.
Confirm both roles are present or have a valid roster channel for the proposal.
Require explicit consent before transferring either duty window.
Check that the target has the required competency and no overlapping roster duty.
Do not grant access or trusted status until the roster amendment and promised consideration are verified.

open_action_examples.situation: A route delay will overlap a pollination window, and the chronometrist wants the forecaster publicly marked as responsible for revising the schedule.
coordinator_checks: Verify the delay record and whether schedule revision falls within the target's accepted duties.
Confirm the target can hear or receive the declaration.
Distinguish a warning from a proven default; do not impose guilt without evidence.
Check whether the proposed status has a defined expiry or removal condition.
Allow the target to refuse new responsibility unless a binding compact already assigns it.

open_action_examples.situation: A quarantined variety needs one controlled substitution, so the tutor proposes creating a warrant limited to one pollination window.
coordinator_checks: Verify the initiator has authority or materials to draft, but not automatically certify, the warrant.
Require the target's consent before attaching their witness mark.
Confirm both parties are near the relevant records or possess authenticated copies.
Limit the created item to one named crop, one window, and one substitution method.
Check seed-lineage, quarantine, and competency requirements before treating the warrant as valid.

open_action_examples.action_name: Pledge a veil for deferred leaf credits
open_action_examples.situation: The veilwright offers a newly fitted protective veil now in exchange for leaf credits after the next audited harvest.
coordinator_checks: Verify the veilwright owns the materials and can create one bounded protective item.
Confirm the parties are close enough to fit or transfer the veil safely.
Require consent to both the deferred payment and any duty attached to using the veil.
Check that pledged leaf credits are not already committed and remain conditional on audited harvest.
Do not confer allergen competency merely from possession; record only the agreed creditor or protected status.

social_rules: Platform access is conditional on complete, signed crop-duty coverage.
Duty transfers count only after the replacement consents and the roster is amended.
Missed duties must be disclosed before access, harvest shares, or leaf credits are reassigned.
Guild competency stamps are required for specialist, quarantined, or delicate crop care.
Harvest shares are settled only after audited weighing and reserve obligations are recorded.
Seed stock cannot be consumed, planted, or pledged without its archive status being disclosed.
Compact amendments require two-thirds support from passengers whose duties or destinations would change.
Allergen exposure, night work, and delay-created burdens must be declared during roster bargaining.
Quarantine ribbons suspend ordinary crop commitments until a qualified substitute plan is certified.
Witnessed fulfilment and transparent allocations strengthen later claims; concealed defaults weaken them.

agent_visual_policy.world_wardrobe_brief: Compact solarpunk railway-greenhouse workwear combining fitted utility layers, Victorian greenhouse tailoring, woven-fibre aprons, brass hardware, enamel role badges, and crop-care protection. Every outfit must communicate institutional role through hat geometry, apron or satchel shape, one top-visible tool, and one icon-only badge within the five-colour canon.
forbidden_aesthetics: antique-market vendor clothing, flea-market eclecticism, or unrelated period costumes
medieval fantasy robes, armour, crowns, heraldry, or wizard attire
cyberpunk streetwear, neon techwear, holographic accessories, or chrome bodysuits
military uniforms, tactical armour, ammunition, or weapons
modern corporate suits, denim casualwear, sportswear, or contemporary branded clothing
space suits, astronaut gear, aviation uniforms, or nautical uniforms
steampunk goggles, excessive gears, smokestack-industrial fashion, or brown leather overload
Victorian aristocratic gowns, corset display, top hats, or ornamental mourning wear
desert, wilderness, cowboy, pirate, or expedition-colonial attire
photoreal textiles, gradients, bloom, colours outside the five-colour canon
readable words, letters, numerals, logos, or text on garments and props

default_rule.palette_notes: Use only #234D3C, #79A85A, #C49A45, #172B2A, and #DCE8C5; brass remains a small accent.
default_rule.silhouette_notes: Compact one-tile figure with large hat-and-shoulder mass, short limbs, and no more than one prominent prop.

visual_consistency_rules: Render strict top-down compact 1x1-tile figures with short limbs and top-visible hats, shoulders, and tools.
Apply a uniform 2 px #172B2A outer outline; use no internal line finer than 1 px.
Keep shadows compact, directly beneath the figure, and inside one tile.
Identify each role with exactly four cues: hat geometry, apron or torso shape, one carried tool, and one icon-only badge.
Limit each sprite to one dominant prop and one small secondary token; avoid silhouette clutter.
Use brass only for clips, scanners, scales, stamps, ferrules, and badge edges.
Represent paperwork as cream geometric panes, tabs, or fans without readable writing.
Protective gear must remain horticultural and railway-specific, never medical-hospital, military, or spacefaring.
Victorian influence is limited to greenhouse tailoring, fitted coats, structured caps, and brass closures; avoid aristocratic costume.
Show institutional affiliation through recurring icons: roster lattice, grafted leaf, balance basket, circular rosette, or destination leaf.
Keep cap, apron, satchel, and tool shapes distinct at 64x64; avoid fine textile patterns, gradients, and translucent effects.

camera.pitch: 90 degrees, no visible horizons or facades
camera.scale_rule: Collision-aligned 1 m tiles; doors 1 tile, aisles 2 tiles, railcars 6 tiles wide; props and sprites remain tile-legible.

visual_canon.lighting: Diffuse glass-roof daylight in #DCE8C5; brass fixtures cast restrained #C49A45 pools; foliage and structures occlude with compact #172B2A shadows directly beneath; no coloured neon or gradients.
architecture: Continuous narrow railcar and platform grid; never isolated dioramas.
Repeating brass greenhouse ribs, clipped corners, glass roof panels, and dark timber sleepers.
Plant bays visibly progress through seedling, flowering, fruiting, harvested, stressed, and quarantined states.
Built-ins use seed-drawer grids, locked harvest cabinets, fold-down ledger desks, cisterns, and tool rails.
Route gates are living espalier signs with destination-specific leaf silhouettes and icon-only enamel signals.
Institution zones differ by recurring symbols: roster lattice, grafted leaf, balance basket, and circular vote rosette.
Runtime overlays resemble translucent glass panes edged in brass, using icons, ticks, crop silhouettes, and palette-only status bands.

terrain.ground: Alternating greenhouse glass, damp timber decking, and planted bay tiles in the bounded palette.
terrain.path: Two-tile dark timber aisle with brass junction strips and leaf-shaped direction inlays.
terrain.edge: Continuous brass rail, greenhouse rib, carriage wall, hedge trellis, or track void; collision boundaries remain explicit.

sprite_language.body_proportion: Compact 1x1-tile figures with large hat-and-shoulder silhouette, short limbs, and top-visible tools.
sprite_language.outline: Uniform 2 px #172B2A outline; no internal line finer than 1 px; shadow stays inside one tile.
sprite_language.role_readability: Roles read through hat geometry, apron shape, carried tool, and one accent badge: conductor cap, gardener apron, delegate satchel, broker ticket fan, passenger crop token.
